blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Oakdale

items.t: Oakdale (Burnaby) is the small residential sub-area in north-east Burnaby along the Lougheed Highway corridor, east of Lougheed Town Centre toward the Coquitlam border. "Oakdale" is the GVR board sub-area name in the SnapStats GVR report for Burnaby; City of Burnaby use of "Oakdale" as an official neighbourhood name was not confirmed on a City source. The City publishes no street-by-street written boundary for the MLS® sub-area — exact boundary streets: Not verified.

Edges and roads: Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) is the main east-west road along the sub-area; North Road forms part of the Burnaby–Coquitlam border to the east, and Highway 1 is reached via the Lougheed / Gaglardi side to the north-west. Neighbours: Lougheed Town Centre and the Cameron / Cariboo side to the west, Forest Hills and Sullivan Heights to the north-west, Burquitlam (Coquitlam) across North Road to the east, and Government Road and Burnaby Lake to the south.
Where the condo stock concentrates: nowhere inside this sub-area — there is none on the current record. Denser apartment forms sit west at Lougheed Town Centre, outside the sub-area.

Transit: Lougheed Town Centre Station (Millennium Line, with the Expo Line Lougheed branch) is west of the sub-area; no SkyTrain station sits inside Oakdale, and specific bus route numbers for the sub-area's streets: Not verified.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect condo buyers in Oakdale

items.t: Burnaby 2050 OCP and the Lougheed town centre: Lougheed is one of Burnaby's town centres, and the Burnaby 2050 Official Community Plan, adopted December 9, 2025, replaces the 1998 OCP and takes precedence over older community-plan land use maps where they conflict — the Lougheed town-centre edge is where plan expectations change fastest, so review the 2050 land use map before assuming density beyond the R1 district.

There are two Oakdales, and the school districts prove it. Oakdale, Burnaby is SD41 (elementary K–7, secondary 8–12, no middle-school tier); Oakdale in Burquitlam is SD43, which does have a middle-school tier. Any school claim that mentions a middle school is describing the Coquitlam side.

The sub-area sits between two SkyTrain nodes but contains neither. Lougheed Town Centre Station is west in Burnaby and Burquitlam Station is east across North Road in Coquitlam — Oakdale's commute story is corridor access, not an in-area station, and bus routes for its streets are not verified.
A zero-sale month is the baseline, not news.

The recreation anchor is on the Lougheed side, not inside the sub-area. The Cameron recreation and park lands serve this area, Burnaby Lake Regional Park and its trail system lie to the south across Lougheed Highway, and the quadrant's library is the Cameron Branch at 9855 Austin Ave (temporary location). A City park inside the Oakdale sub-area itself: Not verified.

The frequent-transit test is the multiplex decider here. Under R1, the jump from 4 units to 6 turns on a lot of at least 281 m² sitting within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop — on this corridor, the lots toward the Lougheed Town Centre station side are where that test can actually be met.

The 2050 OCP now outranks the older plan maps. The Burnaby 2050 OCP (adopted December 9, 2025) takes precedence over older community-plan land use maps where they conflict — at the Lougheed town-centre edge, an older plan map is the wrong document to rely on.

Burnaby community-level context, cited exactly as the report states it, as "Condos & Townhomes" COMBINED and never as a townhome-only figure (SnapStats publishes medians at community level only, not for Oakdale): Condos & Townhomes median sale price $686,000, $763/sqft, sale-to-list 98%, 36 days on market in September 2026; detached median $1,825,000. Burnaby IS a SnapStats-covered community.

Schools: School District 41 (Burnaby) operates 41 elementary and 8 secondary schools city-wide, with no middle-school tier — elementary is K–7 and secondary is 8–12 — which is a practical separator from Oakdale, Coquitlam (SD43, which does have a middle-school tier).

Recreation and library: the Cameron recreation and park lands on the Lougheed side serve this area, Burnaby Lake Regional Park and its trail system lie to the south across Lougheed Highway, and the quadrant's library is the Burnaby Public Library Cameron Branch in the Lougheed Town Centre area, 9855 Austin Ave (temporary location). A City park inside the Oakdale sub-area itself: Not verified. The city's hospital is Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St (Fraser Health), in central Burnaby south-west of Oakdale.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Oakdale

items.t: Burnaby property taxes and utilities: City of Burnaby property taxes for 2026 were due Friday, July 3, 2026; a 5% penalty applies to outstanding current taxes (and to an unclaimed home owner grant) after the July due date, with a further 5% penalty after the September due date; Council approved a 2.9% property tax increase in the 2026–2030 Financial Plan. The detached single-family dwelling water charge is $652.33, rates carry a 5% discount if paid by the due date, and for single-family homes sewer is billed as a sewer parcel tax on the property tax notice. A Coquitlam purchase across North Road carries Coquitlam's tax calendar instead — a different city, a different bill.

Burnaby replaced its entire zoning bylaw in 2026. The Burnaby Zoning Bylaw 2026, No. 14815 (adopted June 9, 2026, in force July 1, 2026) repealed the former bylaw — documents or summaries that still cite Zoning Bylaw No. 4742 (1965), or the old single-family district names, are out of date.

Established house lots off the Lougheed corridor: detached single-family houses only in the current market; denser apartment forms sit west at Lougheed Town Centre, outside the sub-area. A fee-simple lot carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees.

Lot character: typical lot sizes are not verified at sub-area level — no official source read states them. The documented figures are the R1 SSMUH rules: a minimum lot width of 10 m and minimum lot area of 281 m² for SSMUH lots, 3 units on lots up to 280 m², 4 units on larger lots, and 6 units on lots of at least 281 m² within 400 m of a frequent-transit stop. These are zoning thresholds, not a claim about any existing lot's size; the frequent-transit test matters most for lots toward the Lougheed Town Centre station side.

Serviced position, as the City states it: Burnaby's 2026 residential utility notice covers annual water, annual sewer use, a cross-connection device charge where applicable and a residential garbage toter fee; the detached single-family dwelling water charge is $652.33, rates carry a 5% discount if paid by the due date, and for single-family homes sewer is billed as a sewer parcel tax on the property tax notice. Confirm servicing for the specific parcel with the City.

ALR vs non-ALR / flood position: no floodplain, ALR or hazard designation for this sub-area was confirmed in the sources read; no ALR percentage split is stated. Parcel-level hazard and ALR status are property-specific checks: Not verified for individual lots, with ALR status checked in the Agricultural Land Commission's ALR Property and Map Finder.

Market context, labelled correctly: Burnaby IS a SnapStats-covered community; SnapStats has NO land category. September 2026 context only, never land figures: Oakdale sub-area detached inventory 5 / solds 0 and "Condos & Townhomes" combined 0 / 0; Burnaby community detached median $1,825,000 and "Condos & Townhomes" combined median $686,000. Sub-area medians are not verified (community level only).

No bare-land strata plan in Oakdale (Burnaby) was verified: The R1 district permits rowhouses as a form on these lots and provides that lots with two or more primary units may be stratified — a per-lot form, unnamed and uncounted here, not a complex and not a bare-land strata plan.

The City of Lougheed (First Neighbourhood), Austin Road / North Road, Burnaby. NOT COUNTED: a tower project at the Lougheed Town Centre node (described in developer-coverage sources as 4 towers of 31 to 57 storeys with 1,350 condos + 237 rental apartments).

Impressions by Onni, North Road & Cameron Street, Burnaby. NOT COUNTED: developer coverage describes 36- and 32-storey towers with 530 condos + 10 townhomes next to The City of Lougheed shopping centre — Lougheed Town Centre product, west of and outside the Oakdale sub-area.

The Layla, 633 Gardena Drive, Coquitlam. EXCLUDED on two grounds: it is in the City of Coquitlam (the other "Oakdale," in Burquitlam / West Coquitlam), not Oakdale, Burnaby; and it is a 103-unit purpose-built residential rental building offered as a rental asset — rental tenure, not strata product for purchase.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Oakdale

items.t: ALR rules (for completeness — no Oakdale ALR parcel is confirmed here): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s. 6; SPA s. 239; ALCA s. 21(1)); ALC residence caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tiered ($2,500 on 0.8–4 ha; $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha; $10,000 under 0.8 ha; applications by Oct 31) — a flat "$2,500+" line is an ERROR. Check the parcel on ALC mapping before applying any of this.
Clement Parkway). None of it is Oakdale, Burnaby. Verify the municipality — City of Burnaby, SD41 — on every Oakdale hit.

The 2050 OCP moved the goalposts at the town-centre edge: the Burnaby 2050 OCP (adopted December 9, 2025) now governs over older community-plan maps, and Oakdale sits immediately east of the Lougheed town centre, where plan expectations change fastest — a lot priced on an old community-plan map may be priced on a repealed document.

Budget the first-year calendar, not just the price: Burnaby 2026 property taxes were due July 3, 2026 with 5% + 5% penalties after the July and September dates, and the detached-house water charge is $652.33 with a 5% early-payment discount — small numbers that surprise buyers who budgeted only for the purchase.
